_role: Base fixture applied to ALL docs first (was indoxV2Decide01 pre-router). Owns company_id, type, name + guards.

classify.method: apitools find_option over the UNION of every fixture's detect.keywords
classify.type_by_kw: keyword -> type map assembled from all fixtures' detect blocks
classify.fallback: on no keyword match -> aiExtract AI_TYPE, mapped via each fixture's detect.ai_type_map

company.method: apitools find_option over company tax-ids (companies table)

settings_refs._note: max_actions_per_doc counts DISPATCHES since the last restart (indox_action_execution_log, row-carried as __dispatches_since_restart); old_document_months_back is the OldDocumentMonthsBack setting (fixture seeds 6) — the same bound sync discovery applies, so an old document is neither listed nor processed.

steps._desc: the entry gate, before any routing: an old document is terminalised OLD and never extracted

steps.guard: IS_MAIN_DOUBLE (SQL detector in the driver's Enrich Double Lines: biz key COMPANY_ID+DOC_ID, then HASH, then COMPANY_ID+SHORT_DOC_ID)
__dispatches_since_restart >= max_actions_per_doc && STATUS not in (COMPLETED, OLD, ACTION_RESTART)

steps.sets: LOCAL_* / AI_* readings, API_TOOLS_ID, THUMBNAIL, BASE_EXTRACTION_COMPLETED
steps._desc: BaseDocEx01: local (JQExV3 base) + AI (Gemini) readings in parallel, the filename company match; no finals are written here

steps.sets: COMPANY_ID, TYPE, DOC_DATE, COMPANY_BY_SENDER, TYPE_BY_SOURCE, BASE_SELECTION_COMPLETED, BASE_SELECTION_HASH
steps._desc: SelectBase01: company legs (LOCAL/AI, filename, sender, text) and the weighted type vote (engines + the registry's type_authority)

pipeline._then: TYPE resolved -> engine loads fixture[TYPE] and runs its pipeline.steps.
pipeline._optional_extension: the user's design: GLOBAL could ALSO own doc_id + date (a type-aware get_doc_id/get_date after classify), so every doc has company/type/id/date before the type pipeline. That MOVES id/date from the per-type pipeline to GLOBAL (a small, clean behaviour shift).
